body_markdown:
The Country Music Association announced nominees for the 60th Annual CMA Awards, with Reservoir writers contributing to two nominations, including:


**Album of the Year**
*Middle of Nowhere* by Kacey Musgraves, featuring “Mexico Honey” and “Hell on Me,” co-written by Steph Jones


**New Artist of the Year**
Avery Anna


The winners will be announced in a ceremony on November 18th on ABC and Disney+ at 8pm ET, with the taping available on Hulu on November 19th. See the full list of nominees[here](https://musicrow.com/2026/09/breaking-nominees-revealed-for-60th-cma-awards/) .
